item.title: Wary allies show there's no quick fix to Trump's Iran crisis
item.summary: European leaders are hesitant to help Trump secure the Strait of Hormuz, but they know inaction on the Iran war isn't really an option.

item.title: Starmer announces £53m to help households most hit by rising heating oil costs
item.summary: The money will be for "vulnerable" households who have faced a sharp rise in energy bills since the outbreak of the US-Israeli war with Iran.

item.title: Who wants what from the Iran war?
item.summary: Most people, although not everybody, want this war to end as quickly as possible. But on what terms?

item.title: What Iranians are being told about the war
item.summary: Iranian state media's coverage of the war includes inflations of enemy casualties and digital manipulation intended to glorify Iran.

item.title: US names six crew killed in refuelling plane crash in Iraq
item.summary: The aircraft was on a combat mission as part of ongoing US operations against Iran when it crashed in western Iraq on Thursday.

item.title: BBC visits aftermath of Israeli strike on Lebanon that killed family as IDF targets Hezbollah
item.summary: A relative tells BBC those killed were civilians and not Hezbollah operatives, but the Israel Defense Forces says it was targeting "terrorist infrastructure".

item.title: Hamas urges key ally Iran to halt attacks on Gulf states
item.summary: The Palestinian group also affirms Tehran's right to defend itself from "aggression" by the US and Israel.

item.title: Bodies of 84 Iranian sailors killed in US torpedo strike to be repatriated
item.summary: The seamen died when Iranian warship the Iris Dena was sunk on 4 March by a US submarine near Sri Lanka.

item.title: Emirati minister tells BBC Iran must end strikes on Gulf
item.summary: The UAE says more than 1,800 drones and missiles have been projected at the country since the war began.

item.title: 'Fingers on the trigger': Deadly warnings for Iranians being urged to take action
item.summary: Iran's police chief has warned that his forces would treat anyone taking to the streets "at the enemy's request" as an enemy.
